goal.title: English sentence revision
goal.learningTarget: Apply agreement, pronoun reference, and verb tense in standard written American English.
goal.focusAreas: Subject-verb agreement; unambiguous pronoun reference; verb tense.
goal.currentLevel: Practicing sentence-level application rather than terminology recall.
goal.questionDirective: Create exactly five varied sentence-revision application questions in standard written American English: two testing subject-verb agreement, two testing unambiguous pronoun reference, and one testing verb tense. Use five distinct everyday or school/work situations, with difficulty 2 or 3. Supply each complete sentence and make the tested distinction explicit. Avoid discretionary style preferences, collective-noun agreement variation, and questions that only ask for a grammatical label.
